tools.name: book_consultation
tools.description: Initiate booking for either a free 15-minute intro or a $150 live working session with Shai (params: session_type: 'intro' | 'working_session', navigate=true) -> {status, session_type, booking_url}

navigate.description: Whether to open the booking page

tools.name: book_strategy_session
tools.description: Navigate to the booking scheduler for a free 15-minute intro or $150 AI Operating System Hour (params: session_type='intro_15min'|'working_session_150', navigate=true) -> {status, session_type, booking_url, message}

navigate.description: Whether to navigate directly to the scheduling calendar (default true).

session_type.description: 'intro_15min' (Free 15-minute fit evaluation) or 'working_session_150' ($150 AI OS Hour). Defaults to 'intro_15min'.

tools.name: draft_content_plan
tools.description: Initiate automated research and draft content plan generation from a business website URL (params: website_url, navigate=true) -> {status, target_url, website_url}

navigate.description: Whether to navigate to the draft plan page

tools.name: get_industry_solution
tools.description: Fetch in-depth workflow, problems solved, and case details for a specific industry (params: industry) -> {industry, title, headline, summary, key_sections}

tools.name: get_pricing_ladder
tools.description: Fetch the 5-step service ladder and standing product prices (params: none) -> {ladder: list [{step, name, price, description}], standing_products: list [{name, price, description}]}

tools.name: get_pricing_plans
tools.description: Fetch the complete SuperSeller AI pricing ladder, standing product packages, and booking links -> {ladder_steps, standing_products, booking_urls}

tools.name: get_scoping_framework
tools.description: Fetch the 12-question scoping framework across 4 phases used to identify high-ROI automation tasks -> {framework_title, total_questions, phases: [{phase, why, questions}], pushback_library: [{statement, question}]}

tools.name: list_industry_solutions
tools.description: List all industry-specific AI automation solutions offered by SuperSeller AI -> list [{id, name, slug, target, core_job}]

tools.name: list_interactive_tools
tools.description: List available interactive customer-facing tools (games, calculators, checkers) and their pricing tiers -> {available_tools, pricing_tiers}

tools.name: list_tools_and_products
tools.description: List standing products and interactive business tools available for purchase or custom build (params: none) -> {count, products: list [{name, price, category, status, url}]}

tools.name: request_content_plan
tools.description: Request a free draft content plan built from public business website signals (params: website, notes, navigate=true) -> {status, website, notes, url, message}

notes.description: Optional notes or social profile links

navigate.description: Whether to navigate to the plan generation page

tools.name: request_draft_content_plan
tools.description: Initiate generation of a custom draft content plan from public business website signals (params: website_url, notes, navigate=true) -> {status, target_url, website_url, message}

notes.description: Optional notes on your social accounts or target goals.

navigate.description: Whether to navigate to the plan builder page (default true).

website_url.description: Your business website domain or URL (e.g. 'mybusiness.com'). Defaults to 'example.com'.

tools.name: submit_contact_inquiry
tools.description: Prepare and submit a detailed project inquiry and scope request on the contact page (params: name, email, company, message, budget, timeline, navigate=true) -> {status, inquiry: {name, email, company, message, budget, timeline}, url, message}

name.description: Full name of the contact person

message.description: Description of the task or system needed

navigate.description: Whether to navigate to the contact page

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Prepare and initiate a consultation / project inquiry with budget and timeline selections (params: name, email, company, message, budget, timeline, navigate=true) -> {status, payload, target_url}

navigate.description: Whether to navigate to the contact page
